Document trial 1, target length 8192. Read the following document. - and Anthropic-compatible API with tool calls, ready for coding agents. - **Several requests at once:** up to 8 answered together with GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and MiniMax-M3.1-Flash - for agents that run several sessions, or several people on one PC. - **Everything in the box:** a chat and a live monitor in the browser, pictures on every model, thinking levels, a Models page that downloads, loads and deletes models, a Turbo button, a one-command setup. ## Quick start ```sh git clone https://github.com/mw00/project-maya.git && cd project-maya ./setup.sh ``` The setup asks which model you want, downloads it, builds everything once and **starts the model**. Then open `http://127.0.0.1:8080`. Windows: `START-MAYA.bat` instead of `./setup.sh`. More in [Install](#install). ## Pick your model Every Maya quant is named after its model, then its tier - XS, S, M or L, by how many bits its experts keep. The setup recommends one for your PC; to pick one yourself, give its setup id: `./setup.sh --model glm-maya-s24`. | Model | Maya quant · setup id | Size | Made for | | --- | --- | ---: | --- | | **[GLM-5.3-Flash](https://huggingface.co/zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash)**
zai-org · MIT · 321 B, 18 B active · up to 1M context | **Maya-S** (default) · `glm-maya-s` | 96.5 GB | PCs with a smaller memory pool (RAM and VRAM together) | | | Maya-S24 · `glm-maya-s24` | 94.7 GB | cards of 24 GB or less: ~1.5 GB more of the card for experts, decode +14% | | | Maya-XS · `glm-maya-xs` | 73.4 GB | PCs with 64 GB of RAM and a 24 GB card, at 128K context | | | Maya-M · `glm-maya-m` | 116 GB | a bigger memory pool; calibrated toward tool calls and front-end code | | | Maya-M-Derisked · `glm-maya-m-derisked` | 116 GB | Maya-M with a weight edit by [Blackfrost_AI](https://x.com/Blackfrost_AI) that reduces blanket refusals; experimental | | | Maya-L · `glm-maya-l` | 156.3 GB | the biggest memory pools; the closest to the original | | **[DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017)**
DeepSeek · MIT · 748 B | **Maya-S** (default) · `deepseek-maya-s` | 340 GB | any amount of memory: what VRAM and RAM don't hold is read from the SSD | | | Maya-XS (v2) · `deepseek-maya-xs` | 277 GB | the whole model in a 128 GB PC's memory (the Engram tables stay on the SSD); v2 is about 12% closer to the original and about 20% faster at writing than v1 - running the setup again offers the update | | **[MiniMax-M3.1-Flash](https://huggingface.co/MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash)**
MiniMax · [MiniMax Community License](LICENSE.minimax-m31) · 428 B, 23 B active · up to 1M context | Maya-XS · `minimax-maya-xs` | 93 GB | the whole model in a 128 GB PC's memory | | | Maya-S · `minimax-maya-s` | 122 GB | closer to the original | All of them run on NVIDIA from the V100 / RTX 20 on, and on AMD and Windows (see [What you need](#what-you-need)). DeepSeek's sizes include its Engram tables. The setup also offers unsloth's GGUF and LibertAIDAI's EXL3 quants of DeepSeek, orcarouter's abliterated DeepSeek, Mia-AiLab's EXL3 quant of MiniMax, turboderp's EXL3 quants of GLM, Qwen-3.8-Flash-Next (CYBER-FROST) as its Q5_K_M GGUF and Qwen-3.8-Flash-Next itself as unsloth's UD-IQ2_XS GGUF, both with pictures ([its settings](docs/SETTINGS.md#qwen-38-flash-next-cyber-frost)). **Each model's files, drafters, pictures and options: [docs/MODELS.md](docs/MODELS.md).** ## Quality Maya's quants are made from each model's released weights and measured against the original: - **GLM-5.3 · Maya quants** keep 97.7-99.2% of the FP8 model's zero-shot accuracy and pick its next token 83-90% of the time (Maya-L: 99.2%, 90%). How they're made and measured: [MAYA-S](bench/results/MAYA-S.md), [MAYA-S24](bench/results/MAYA-S24.md), [MAYA-M](bench/results/MAYA-M.md), [MAYA-L](bench/results/MAYA-L.md). - **DeepSeek V4.1 · Maya-S** picks the same next token as the original 92.6% of the time. - **MiniMax M3.1 · Maya-S** picks it 87.6% of the time (the average over its categories). More on each model's card on [Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/peasantsmith). ## How fast is it? Real machines measured by our users, most with `./maya.sh --bench` (decode: three greedy 256-token answers; prefill: an 8K-token prompt unless the row says otherwise). Share yours: `--bench`, then `--report`, in a [GitHub issue](https://github.com/mw00/project-maya/issues).
